subhead: Our own room, every Monday at the Log Cabin Bar & Grill in Olympia. Twelve spots, eight minutes each, claimed in advance. No clipboard, no bucket, no standing around hoping.
motto: Sign up, show up, go up.

poster.alt: Log Cabin Comedy Open Mic flyer. The Stoned Goose lockup above the title, every Monday, 12 spots at 8 minutes each, sign up online in advance, show starts at 7 PM, at the Log Cabin Bar & Grill, 7035 Pacific Ave SE, Olympia, WA 98503.

signup.heading: Take a spot.
signup.body: Four Mondays are open at a time. Twelve spots a night, eight minutes each. Pick your Monday, leave your name, and the spot is yours. You will get a confirmation email with your spot number. The list closes when it is full, and a new Monday posts every Tuesday morning.
signup.privacyNote: You can see how many spots are left. You cannot see who has them, and neither can anyone else. The running order is deleted after the night. We keep your name, email and Instagram handle on our comedian list so we can contact you about bookings and shows. Your confirmation email has a link to come off that list, and a link to release your spot if you cannot make it.
signup.offlineText: That did not go through. Try again, or email us and we will put you down by hand:

howItWorks.heading: Sign up here.
howItWorks.body: Twelve spots per Monday, four Mondays on the list at once. Take one and it is yours. Turn up without one and you are watching, not performing.

howItWorks.heading: Eight minutes.
howItWorks.body: Eight, not nine, not a quick one more. Show starts at 7:00 PM. Running order goes up the night of, so get there early enough to find out where you are.

howItWorks.heading: Then stay.
howItWorks.body: The comics who stick around for the rest of the list are the comics who get better. Work the room, watch the room.
